name: clamp
snippet: const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));

name: lerp
snippet: const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

name: lerpAngle
snippet: const lerpAngle = (a, b, t) => { let d=((b-a+Math.PI)%(Math.PI*2))-Math.PI; if(d<-Math.PI)d+=Math.PI*2; return a+d*t; };

name: distance2D
snippet: const distance2D = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.z - b.z);

name: safeLocalGet
snippet: const safeLocalGet = key => { try { return window.localStorage?.getItem(key) ?? null; } catch { return null; } };

name: safeLocalSet
snippet: const safeLocalSet = (key, value) => { try { window.localStorage?.setItem(key, value); return true; } catch { return false; } };

name: safeLocalRemove
snippet: const safeLocalRemove = key => { try { window.localStorage?.removeItem(key); return true; } catch { return false; } };

name: isStandalone
snippet: const isStandalone = () => window.matchMedia?.('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || navigator.standalone === true || safeLocalGet('otthos_installed') === '1';
